s01-01-grave-cb3166.wav.text: In those days a decree went out from Caesar Augustus that all the world should be registered.

s01-02-story-be18ba.wav.text: So Joseph took Mary, who was expecting a baby, to Bethlehem, the town of King David.

s02-01-story-dbb258.wav.text: While they were there, the baby came.

s02-02-grave-3a33ea.wav.text: And she gave birth to her firstborn son and wrapped him in swaddling cloths and laid him in a manger,

s02-03-grave-1a3bf4.wav.text: because there was no place for them in the inn.

s02-04-pivot-8b2cea.wav.text: A manger is a feeding trough.

s02-05-story-7476e1.wav.text: The king was laid where the animals ate.

s03-01-story-a59727.wav.text: In the fields nearby, shepherds were watching their sheep through the night.

s03-03-grave-615866.wav.text: And an angel of the Lord appeared to them, and the glory of the Lord shone around them,

s03-04-grave-37e470.wav.text: and they were filled with great fear.

s04-02-grave-3ee6ba.wav.text: For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Savior, who is Christ the Lord.

s04-03-pivot-b6c1dd.wav.text: Then the whole sky filled with angels, praising God.

s04-04-grave-0181f9.wav.text: Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace among those with whom he is pleased!

s05-01-story-9df5fc.wav.text: The shepherds ran into town and found the baby, lying in a manger, just as the angel said.

s05-03-grave-119cf1.wav.text: But Mary treasured up all these things, pondering them in her heart.

s06-01-talk-d6776a.wav.text: God's king didn't arrive in a palace.

s06-02-story-1d98fd.wav.text: He was laid in a feeding trough, and the first to hear were men nobody invited.
